description: blueteam.ee's rules for fabric-pr arm. boundary.paths: the site is an Astro build over pre-built Landkit bundles, installed with npm and deployed by hand-uploading dist/ to an i-MSCP host, so its boundary is the manifests and lockfile that decide what installs and runs (package.json, package-lock.json, .npmrc), the build configuration (astro.config.*, tsconfig*.json, which load plugins and code at build time), the harness wiring (.claude/: settings, hooks, commands; .mcp.json), the ignore file that keeps .env out of a commit (.env* at any depth, .gitignore), CI (.github/, none today), the deployment directory and any deployment script (deploy/, deploy*, upload*), a certificate or key file (*.pem), and words where the boundary is a file anywhere (secret, credential, token, key, auth). boundary.exempt is dropped first, but never under .claude/: Markdown prose, src/content/ and .agent-fabric/. No classes. waiver_role is null: only the owner waives the boundary. The site's source and static files (src/, public/) are outside the boundary since 2026-10-19: brand-comms arms them without a second word (boundary.changes).

changes.2026-10-19 content leaves the boundary: Content leaves the boundary so brand-comms arms it without a second word; the harness, CI, environment, ignore file, build configuration, manifests, deploy and secret files stay (devex-tooling's REQUEST 01a152a4-df8d-7c64-8f47-12992b3ca534; the owner chose narrowing in fabric-coordinator's session, 2026-10-19).

direct.description: Direct to main: brand-comms commits copy, content, pages, components, styles, fonts and images straight to main (the owner, 2026-10-10). By pull request: what decides what installs, builds, deploys or runs (the manifests, lockfiles and .npmrc, astro.config.* and tsconfig*.json, other *.config.* and tool-version files, Makefile/Dockerfile, wrangler/netlify/vercel and public/_headers and _redirects), the harness wiring (.claude/, .mcp.json), CI, hooks, the deploy and upload scripts, .env* and .gitignore, every script (shell, Python, Ruby, Perl, PowerShell, and JavaScript or TypeScript outside src/, vendor bundles under public/ included, and anything under bin/, scripts/ or tools/), any file whose git mode is executable, and secret-shaped names (secret, credential, api key, private or signing key, password; an access, api, auth, refresh, bearer, bot, npm, gh, github, slack, oauth or oauth2 token; a service-account, sa, private, gcp or google key.json; a deploy key; an ssh id_rsa, id_dsa, id_ecdsa or id_ed25519 key and any suffixed one; .netrc or _netrc, .htpasswd, .pgpass, .pypirc, .docker/config.json, kubeconfig or .kube/config, a gpg secring or pubring; auth.json; anything under keys/; .pem/.p12/.p8/.pfx/.key/.jks/.keystore/.ppk). Styles, design tokens, fonts, images, content and pages are direct.
